description: A single agent-readable Bootstrap entry point can initialize new existing or previously initialized repositories. It installs project state stack-appropriate Coding Rules and the correct agent integration before running structural verification.
acceptance_criteria: Bootstrap distinguishes greenfield legacy and already initialized repositories
Bootstrap creates Product Feature Coding Rules configuration and Progress state in dependency order
Bootstrap installs the appropriate agent integration and verifies the resulting structure
